statements.text_en: Red round company seal reading 'DONGGUAN PRECISION HOUSINGS CO LTD' and 'Dedicated shipping seal'.

verdict.summary_en: Chinese/English delivery note SN-260730-216 dated 2026-07-30 from Dongguan Precision Housings to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, referencing POs 4500318682 and 4500318684. It lists 134 PCS of CMP-GAM-003 (268 packages) and 23 PCS of CMP-GAM-006 (11 packages). Total is 279 packages and gross weight is 3069 kg, carried by Nordhav Shipping A/S. It has a red shipping seal. The receiving signature line is blank. There are no handwritten corrections.
red_flags: The note lists two POs (4500318682, 4500318684) but does not say which PO each line belongs to.
The receiving signature line (收货签字) is blank, so there is no receipt confirmation on this copy.

Quantities are printed as '134.000' and '23.000'. They are read as 134 and 23 PCS under the Chinese decimal-point convention. If the period were a thousands separator, the quantities would be far larger. The package counts (268 and 11) are consistent with the smaller reading.
observations: The red company seal overlaps the unit and package columns, including the header, the 'PCS' on line 2 and the '11'. The values are still readable.
The seal contains no date or numbers.
The receiving signature line and the remarks field are empty.
There are no handwritten marks or strike-throughs.
The page has a barcode at the top right, which was not decoded.
The page is slightly skewed, as in a scan.
